Name: Daily Boons and Banes
Author: melodyhalftone
Description:
[u][b][size=5]What is this:[/size][/b][/u]
This mod will try to apply a buff or debuff at the start of each day. These buffs cover all aspect of the game from farming, foraging, fishing, mining, and combat. The buff will last x hours in game time or endless depends on a configurable setting. There will also be some flavor text when you wake up that describes your feeling based on the buff or debuff you received. This can be toggled. Daily Luck can also influence if you get buff or debuff, but this is also configurable.

The buffs will be distributed into 4 categories: Major Boon, Minor Boon, Minor Bane, and Major Bane. The chance of getting a buff from a specific category can be configured or turned off completely. Each individual buff and debuff from each category can also be turned on or off.

[u][size=4][b]Potential Buffs & Debuffs[/b]
[/size][/u]Major Boons:
[list]
[*][b]Blazing Fast[/b]: +3 Speed
[*][b]Vicious[/b]: +3 Attack, +5% Crit Rate, +5% Crit Damage, +5% Weapon Speed, +5% Weapon Precision, +5% Knockback
[*][b]Rock Steady[/b]: +3 Defense, +3 Immunity, +30 Max HP, +5% Damage Reflection Chance
[*][b]Green Thumb[/b]: +3 Farming Skill, +5% chance to yield additional crop when harvesting (applies to non multi-yield crop too)
[*][b]Thalassophilia[/b]: +3 Fishing Skill, +5% Treasure Chance, +5% Fish Hook Chance. +5% Fish Hook Speed, +5% Treasure, +5% Bobber Bar Size, -5% Fishing Difficulty
[*][b]Natures Gift[/b]: +3 Foraging Skill, +5% chance to yield additional forageables and wood.
[*][b]Rich Vein[/b]: +3 Mining Skill. +5% chance to find additional minerals, +5% ladder chance
[/list]﻿Minor Boons:
[list]
[*][b]Speedy[/b]: +1 Speed
[*][b]Strong[/b]: +1 Attack
[*][b]Sturdy[/b]: +1 Defense
[*][b]Nature Touched[/b]: +1 Farming Skill
[*][b]Angler[/b]: +1 Fishing Skill
[*][b]Bountiful[/b]: +1 Foraging Skill
[*][b]Digging[/b]: +1 Mining Skill
[/list]Minor Banes:
[list]
[*][b]Sluggish[/b]: -1 Speed
[*][b]Weak[/b]: -1 Attack
[*][b]Unsteady[/b]: -1 Defense
[*][b]Unearthly[/b]: -1 Farming Skill
[*][b]Aquaphobic[/b]: -1 Fishing Skill
[*][b]Empty Hand:[/b] -1 Foraging Skill
[*][b]Sparse Deposit[/b]: -1 Mining Skill
[/list]Major Banes:
[list]
[*][b]Snail[/b]: -3 Speed
[*][b]Feeble[/b]: -3 Attack, -5% Crit Rate, -5% Crit Damage, -5% Weapon Speed, -5% Weapon Precision, -5% Knockback
[*][b]Fragile[/b]: -3 Defense, -3 Immunity, -30 Max HP, +5% Double Damage Received Chance
[*][b]Black Thumb[/b]: -3 Farming Skill. -5% chance to yield a crop when harvesting (i.e. 5% to not get a crop when harvesting)
[*][b]Skunking[/b]: -3 Fishing Skill, -5% Treasure Chance, -5% Fish Hook Chance. -5% Fish Hook Speed, -5% Treasure, -5% Bobber Bar Size, +5% Fishing Difficulty
[*][b]Natures Wrath[/b]: -3 Foraging Skill, -5% chance to yield forageables and wood
[*][b]Desolated Mine[/b]: -3 Mining Skill. -5% chance to yield minerals, -5% ladder chance
[/list]

[size=5][u][b]Installation:[/b][/u][/size]﻿
﻿1. Download and Install the Latest Version of SMAPI.﻿﻿
﻿2. Download and extract the mod into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.﻿﻿﻿
﻿3. Done

[u][size=5][b]Configuration:[/b][/size][/u]
[list]
[*]Enable Mod: Toggle if the mod should be on or off. can be turned on or off mid game and it will affect if you are eligible for buff or debuff the next day.
[*]Show Daily Message: Toggle if you want the little pop up text that describe the farmer's feeling based on the buff or debuff they received.
[*]Daily Luck: Toggle if you want your daily luck to influence the category of buff or debuff you receive.
[*]Minimal Buff Duration: Minimal number of in game hours the buff or debuff should last. 20 is Endless
[*]Maximum Buff Duration: Maximum number of in game hours the buff or debuff should last. 20 is Endless
[*]Boon & Bane Weight: This is where you set the likelihood a buff is chosen from each category. Higher weight means more likely the category is chosen. 0 turns off the category completely.
[*]Category Specific Settings: toggle to turn on and off a buff from that particular category (e.g. If you do not like -3 Speed ever, you can uncheck Snail from Major Bane Setting, and it will never be selected)
[/list]
[u][b][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/b][size=5][b]:
[/b][/size][/u]Should be multiplayer compatible (though I have not done extensive testing on this)
Works with existing save.
